annotations.title: Show the latest AI answers to one tracked prompt

description: Use this when someone wants to read what the AI engines actually answered to one of their tracked prompts. Returns the most recent answer from each engine, whether the brand was named or cited, which brands were named, and the pages each answer cited.

brand.description: Which brand, by name or id, when the account tracks more than one. Leave empty to use the only brand; list_brands shows them all.
